questions.q: If n(A) = 3 and n(B) = 4, how many elements are in A × B?
What is the domain of f(x) = √(x − 2)?
questions.explanation: The expression under the root must be non-negative.

questions.q: What is the range of f(x) = x² for x ∈ ℝ?
If A has 2 elements and B has 3 elements, how many relations from A to B are there?
questions.explanation: Relations are subsets of A × B, and 2⁶ = 64.

questions.q: A function from A to B assigns ____.
options: exactly one element of B to each element of A
at least one element of B to each element of A
two elements of A to B
questions.explanation: Every input has exactly one output.
